title: QR Print: larger previews and a cleaner workflow
lede: Larger centered previews, an enlarged inspection dialog, clearer gear and custom-label controls, and a more readable USB print area. The approved print pixels and scan identity are unchanged.

stats.n: 388×152 for the sample at desktop width; scales proportionally on smaller screens.
PNG bytes match the pre-refinement body and unit samples.

sections.heading: A clearer print sheet
sections.note: Matched 1440×1100 staff-fixture captures with the same four labels, fixed clock and zero document/catalogue/sheet scroll. The baseline was rebuilt from its retained source in an isolated snapshot.

pairs.title: Read each label before printing
pairs.beforeCap: Small previews beside the CSV-era controls.
pairs.afterCap: Larger centered previews, readable template names and distinct printer controls.

shots.title: Enlarged preview
shots.cap: Click a preview to inspect the same bitmap. Escape closes it and restores focus.

sections.heading: Custom labels read as a deliberate workflow

shots.title: SD cards, text and numbers
shots.cap: Clear section names, readable fields and specific Add actions.

sections.heading: Smaller screens retain the whole layout
sections.note: After-only phone evidence. The split layout begins at xl so the normal app sidebar does not squeeze picker titles or clip Add controls.

shots.title: Phone-width sheet
shots.cap: Large previews preserve aspect ratio; the review shortcut remains available.

sections.heading: Live dark appearance
sections.note: After-only capture from the user’s Chrome window; the accepted 1/1 print receipt remains visible.

shots.title: Refined helper
shots.cap: Larger centered preview and clearer gear, printer and completion controls.

changes.was: 44 px preview with little room to inspect text or QR.
changes.now: 76 px centered preview, 152 px inspection view, preserved aspect ratio and visible loading state.

changes.was: Native template filenames, generic Add actions and tightly packed picker controls.
changes.now: Product template names, specific custom-label actions, clearer search/filter structure and a distinct USB panel.

changes.was: A wider sheet could squeeze the picker beside the app sidebar.
changes.now: Two columns begin at xl; narrower layouts stack cleanly and retain the review shortcut.

verification: 76 focused tests and TypeScript pass; final build status is recorded in build.txt.
Dialog name, Escape/focus return, all custom generators, preview centering and four viewport sizes passed browser checks without page errors.
USB and CSV regression browser checks pass after refinement.
1024 px viewport with 256 px sidebar space retains a 434.83 px picker title column and unclipped Add controls.
Normal preview PNG bytes are identical before and after refinement. The earlier integrated physical label was user-approved.
notes: Local source only; no commit, push or deployment. Authenticated feature-route proof remains open.
The UI refinement changes display sizing and controls; it does not change the approved printer bitmap.
Matched receipts establish retained-source/image provenance, not authenticated server behavior.
